title: A stock rising at the net flow
caption: The net flow is 10 − 6 = 4 L/min, so the stock rises along a straight line of gradient 4: from 100 L to 140 L in 10 minutes.
alt: A straight rising line of bath volume against time, from 100 litres at 0 minutes to 140 litres at 10 minutes.
description: The inflow is 10 L/min and the outflow 6 L/min, so the net flow is 4 L/min.
dS/dt = 4 is constant, so S is a straight line with gradient 4.
After 10 minutes the bath holds 100 + 4 × 10 = 140 L.
